platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; editorial airplay consideration applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WXYC explicitly directs music submissions and distribution questions to md@wxyc.org, but publishes no file-format, attachment, download-link, metadata, clean-edit or release-window requirements.
